dct_description_sm: This dataset contains one ORCA DFT input template used for all calculations, and individual ORCA output files for each spherical fragment radius (4, 5, and 6 Å) and the full-protein calculation. The inputs share the same settings, while the outputs differ according to each fragment’s local environment.
dct_title_s: Divide and Correlate: Mapping Electronic Correlations in Proteins via Local Cut-Wise Reconstruction
